Ring Out Linux AppImage
Credits, disclaimer, licensing, and source offer
================================================

DISCLAIMER
----------

This package was assembled from the Ring Out project maintained by Jack Poison
with AI assistance. It is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, or connected to Nintendo, Bandai Namco, Dolphin, AppImage, or the
other projects named below.

No game data or game code is included. You supply a GameCube disc image that
you made and are entitled to use. Setup extracts it and builds a private native
module on your machine. Do not redistribute that generated material.

CREDIT WHERE IT IS DUE
----------------------

  Dolphin Emulator Project
    Graphics, audio, input, save states, GameCube hardware emulation, and the
    Vulkan renderer used by the runtime. GPL-2.0-or-later.
    https://dolphin-emu.org

  ExpansionPak - ModernGekko
    The chassis that hosts a statically recompiled game inside Dolphin and the
    StaticRecomp core that bridges native code and the emulator.
    https://github.com/ExpansionPak/ModernGekko

  ExpansionPak - DolRecomp
    The static recompiler that translates GameCube PowerPC code into C.
    GPL-3.0-or-later. https://github.com/ExpansionPak/DolRecomp

  Dear ImGui, SDL, and the other vendored runtime dependencies
    See LICENSES/Dolphin and the matching repository revision in SOURCE.txt.

  AppImage project
    The type-2 runtime that mounts or extracts this image. Its exact seven
    static components, versions, sources, and notice paths are recorded in
    APPIMAGE-RUNTIME-COMPONENTS.tsv. Full notices, including mimalloc and the
    libfuse LGPL-2.1-only text, are under LICENSES/AppImage-runtime.

  Debian
    Redistributable support libraries are copied from the pinned Debian 12
    build container. SYSTEM-LIBRARIES.tsv records each bundled DSO's binary and
    source package version and a matching source URL. TOOLCHAIN-COMPONENTS.tsv
    separately records glibc, GCC runtime, zlib, and libstdc++ incorporated via
    static linkage into DolRecomp and moderngekko-run. Debian copyright notices
    are included under LICENSES, with offline copies of the canonical texts
    they reference under LICENSES/Debian-common-licenses.

  Bandai Namco Entertainment
    The original game, code, and assets. They are not included or redistributed
    and remain the property of their respective owners.

  Cheat-code authors and publishers
    Action Replay codes are published community data (Codejunkies, via Almar's
    Guides). None were authored by this project.

LICENSING AND MATCHING SOURCE
-----------------------------

The runtime is Dolphin-derived GPL-2.0-or-later combined with GPL-3.0-or-later
ModernGekko and DolRecomp code. The combined package is distributed under
GPLv3-compatible terms. Individual third-party components retain their own
compatible terms in LICENSES.

SOURCE.txt records the Ring Out repository, commit-addressed tree, and source
archive. For a publishable tagged build, that revision contains the matching
full ModernGekko, Dolphin, DolRecomp, AppRun, packaging sources, and recorded
rebuild workflow. An image whose SOURCE.txt says "Validation only: yes" was
built from a local worktree and is QA evidence, not a redistributable release.
The adjacent checksummed RingOut-*-appimage-runtime-sources.tar.zst asset is the
designated same-release source/relink companion for the static AppImage prefix;
it contains the exact type2-runtime tree, libfuse and squashfuse sources, mount
patch, notices, and rebuild helper. Keep that bundle available with the image.
BUILD-ENVIRONMENT.tsv lists the exact Debian packages and build-tool versions
used for this artifact. Keep SOURCE.txt, CREDITS.txt, SYSTEM-LIBRARIES.tsv,
TOOLCHAIN-COMPONENTS.tsv, APPIMAGE-RUNTIME-COMPONENTS.tsv,
BUILD-ENVIRONMENT.tsv, LICENSES, and the corresponding-source bundle with the
AppImage when redistributing it.
